title: To Workspace
text: Log data to workspace from Simulink model, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Limit data points to last} sets Number of samples to log; {Variable name} sets the name of variable for saved, {Decimation}, {Save format} sets the format for data logged to workspace, {Save 2-D signals as} sets the arrangement of 2-D sample values in logged data 3-D, {Log fixed-point data as a fi object} sets the data type for logged fixed-point data and {Sample time} sets the sampling interval and optional time offset. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data to log to workspace scalar | vector | matrix | array | bus

params.name: Variable name
params.values: Name of variable for saved data simout (default) | string | character vector

params.name: Limit data points to last
params.values: Number of samples to log inf (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Save format
params.values: Format for data logged to workspace Timeseries (default) | Structure With Time | Structure | Array

params.name: Save 2-D signals as
params.values: Arrangement of 2-D sample values in logged data 3-D array (concatenate along third dimension) (default) | 2-D array (concatenate along first dimension)

params.name: Log fixed-point data as a fi object
params.values: Data type for logged fixed-point data on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sampling interval and optional time offset -1 (default) | scalar
